waypoints.name: Lewis Pass
waypoints.advice: 313 km in you reach Lewis Pass. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Murchison, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Christchurch → Hanmer Springs is 142 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Hanmer Springs → Lewis Pass climbs about 864 m in 48 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Lewis Pass → Murchison drops about 864 m over 80 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Hanmer Springs → Lewis Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 83 km. 864 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Lewis Pass → Murchison
scenicChapters.narrative: 140 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

lewis-pass-highway.story: 469 km from Christchurch to the finish, about 6 h 22 of riding. It goes by way of Hanmer Springs and Lewis Pass. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
